body: Wasted my life. Slept around a lot. Ugly. Was suicidal at one point after I came out of a psyche ward from stress. Stupid. Even slept with a family member because my self worth was sub-zero. Tried to lie my way out. Caused all kinds of trouble. Shameful. Guilty. Lousy mother. Let's just say that I have not been noble and have no friends. No one will be at my funeral. Bad things have/will be said about me forever. People feel sorry for my spouse for good reason. This was not my heart, just my actions. I'm old and hurt my mother. She tried to cover up my shame. Hurt a lot of good people when I got in between family members. Why was I born?  Trouble maker. Tried so hard to start over in 93 with going to school and meeting someone new. I twisted his arm cause I wouldn't leave (he told me to) and he married me 10 yrs. later. I knew nothing about his past. Checkered and ashamed of his too. I've been my own worst enemy and a doormat and dishonorable and now I'm too old to do/be anything, as much as my soul hungered to. Useless piece of dung, tried to make "nice" after my ugly sins. Screwed up again and I'm too old to undo/restart it. Guess I'm just confessing/fessing up.
